tools.name: dropbox_sign_get_account
tools.description: Get info about the API-key owner's Dropbox Sign account (id, email, quotas, plan). API: GET /account.

tools.name: dropbox_sign_get_team
tools.description: Get the caller's team, including its members and invited members. API: GET /team.

tools.name: dropbox_sign_list_signature_requests
tools.description: List signature requests the account can access, newest first. Paginated. API: GET /signature_request/list.

tools.name: dropbox_sign_get_signature_request
tools.description: Get the status and details of a single signature request by id. API: GET /signature_request/{signature_request_id}.

tools.name: dropbox_sign_get_signed_files_url
tools.description: Get a temporary URL to download the signed document(s) for a signature request. API: GET /signature_request/files_as_file_url/{signature_request_id}.

tools.name: dropbox_sign_list_templates
tools.description: List reusable templates the account can access. Paginated. API: GET /template/list.

tools.name: dropbox_sign_get_template
tools.description: Get a single template's fields, roles, and metadata by id. API: GET /template/{template_id}.

tools.name: dropbox_sign_send_with_template
tools.description: Sends a signature request built from template(s) to the given signers. When test_mode is true (default) it does NOT send real emails; set test_mode=false to send a REAL, legally-binding signature request. API: POST /signature_request/send_with_template.

tools.name: dropbox_sign_cancel_signature_request
tools.description: Cancels an incomplete signature request. Destructive — signers can no longer sign. API: POST /signature_request/cancel/{signature_request_id}.

tools.name: dropbox_sign_remind_signature_request
tools.description: Sends a reminder email to a signer for a pending signature request. API: POST /signature_request/remind/{signature_request_id}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: dropbox_sign_get_account, dropbox_sign_get_signed_files_url · Private data: dropbox_sign_get_signed_files_url · Public sink: dropbox_sign_get_account, dropbox_sign_send_with_template, dropbox_sign_cancel_signature_request, dropbox_sign_remind_signature_request.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: dropbox_sign_get_account, dropbox_sign_get_signed_files_url · Private data: dropbox_sign_get_signed_files_url · Public sink: dropbox_sign_get_account, dropbox_sign_send_with_template, dropbox_sign_cancel_signature_request, dropbox_sign_remind_signature_request

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
